script_approved: 2026-09-26 founder's blind pick, round 2 (reel_scripts/kodaikanal__december.json); passes script_gate against reel-data.json.
method: KEYFRAME-FIRST, same as triund__first_trek_kf: refs, then a free Nano Banana still per beat, then Frames to Video on Veo 3.1 Lite from each still. Motion + sound prompts only.
setting_basis: Home interior, then a generic cottage window and a quiet misty lakeside path in the Palani hills. The footage makes no crowd, price or weather claim; the script's facts are the month verdicts and crowd months.
look: Soft natural light, gentle mist, natural colour, anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, photorealistic, cinematic. Faces are never in close-up and no one looks at the camera. A phone or laptop screen is only a soft glow, never legible. No other people. No music, no speech, no voiceover, no text, captions, logos or watermark.

refs.name: ref_man
refs.prompt: Full-length photograph of a man in his late twenties with wavy black hair and glasses, wearing a maroon crew-neck sweater, beige chinos and white sneakers, standing indoors in soft window light, three-quarter view, neutral expression, photorealistic, no text.

refs.name: ref_woman
refs.prompt: Full-length photograph of a woman in her late twenties with short dark bob-cut hair, wearing a cream cable-knit cardigan over a navy dress, black leggings and grey sneakers, standing indoors in soft window light, three-quarter view, neutral expression, photorealistic, no text.

refs.name: ref_lake
refs.prompt: A quiet path beside a calm hill lake in soft morning mist, tall eucalyptus and pine trees on the slopes, a wooden bench by the water, photorealistic, no people, no text.

keyframes.name: kf_s1
keyframes.prompt: Medium shot at a small home work desk in soft daylight: the man in the maroon sweater sits at a laptop, its screen only a soft glow, typing; the woman in the cream cardigan stands behind his chair with a hand on his shoulder, smiling.

keyframes.name: kf_s2
keyframes.prompt: Same room, same two people and the same light as the reference, moments later: the man holds up his phone and studies it, its screen only a soft glow, head tilted; the woman leans down beside him to read.

keyframes.name: kf_s3
keyframes.prompt: Same room, same two people and the same light as the reference: the man turns back to the laptop and types, smiling; the woman gives him a light pat on the shoulder, pleased.

keyframes.name: kf_s4
keyframes.prompt: Medium shot beside a wooden cottage window in soft misty morning light: the woman in the cream cardigan holds a steel tumbler of filter coffee in both hands, steam rising, eucalyptus trees and mist outside the window.

keyframes.name: kf_s5
keyframes.prompt: Wide shot from the side: the man in the maroon sweater and the woman in the cream cardigan stroll slowly along the empty misty lakeside path, her arm through his, tall trees around the calm water.

keyframes.name: kf_s6
keyframes.prompt: Wide shot from behind: the man in the maroon sweater and the woman in the cream cardigan sit side by side on the wooden bench by the calm misty lake, looking out at the water and the trees.

shots.prompt: The camera holds still. He types and she smiles over his shoulder.
shots.sound: Quiet room tone, soft keyboard taps, a bird outside.

shots.prompt: The camera holds still. He looks at the phone and hesitates; she leans in to read.
shots.sound: Quiet room tone, a bird outside.

shots.prompt: The camera holds still. He types a few keys and smiles; she pats his shoulder.
shots.sound: Quiet room tone, a few soft keyboard taps.

shots.prompt: The camera holds still. Steam rises from the tumbler; she sips slowly and looks out of the window.
shots.sound: Soft morning birdsong, a distant breeze, the faint clink of steel.

shots.prompt: The camera holds still as they stroll slowly along the lakeside path, mist drifting over the water.
shots.sound: Footsteps on a gravel path, water lapping softly, birdsong.

shots.prompt: The camera holds still. They sit on the bench; she leans her head on his shoulder as the mist drifts.
shots.sound: Water lapping softly, distant birds, a light breeze.

en:
We'd planned Kodaikanal for November.
I'd already applied for leave.

Then I checked NakshIQ.
November was a go.
But it was peak crowd month.

December was a go too.
Without the peak.
So I moved my leave to December.

December came.
Filter coffee by the window.
Our whole day, at our own pace.

Same place. Same plan.
Just a better month for us.
Travel intelligence is seeing past the first yes.
NakshIQ.
hi:
हमने नवंबर में कोडाइकनाल जाने का सोचा था।
मैंने छुट्टी के लिए अप्लाई भी कर दिया था।

फिर मैंने NakshIQ देखा।
नवंबर, गो था।
पर वो भीड़ का पीक महीना था।

दिसंबर भी गो था।
और भीड़ का पीक नहीं।
तो मैंने छुट्टी दिसंबर में कर ली।

दिसंबर आया।
खिड़की के पास फ़िल्टर कॉफ़ी।

वही जगह। वही प्लान।
बस हमारे लिए बेहतर महीना।
ट्रैवल इंटेलिजेंस मतलब, पहली हाँ के आगे भी देखना।
NakshIQ.
